cond_0001.intro: The Advanced Quality Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring the highest standards of quality throughout the product development and manufacturing processes. They will be responsible for leading advanced quality planning initiatives, implementing continuous improvement measures, and driving root cause analysis to resolve quality issues. This role requires strong analytical skills, deep knowledge of automotive quality standards, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
What you will do:
Lead APQP activities for new product launches, ensuring compliance with customer requirements and automotive quality standards. Develop and maintain control plans, PFMEAs, and other APQP documentation. Collaborate with design, engineering, and manufacturing teams to identify and mitigate quality risks early in the product development process. Monitor and enforce adherence to quality standards in all stages of the manufacturing process. Conduct regular audits to assess compliance with quality specifications and standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement in product design and manufacturing processes. Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost reduction through the application of lean manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies. Drive initiatives to optimize quality control processes and enhance product reliability. Lead root cause analysis investigations for quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions. Utilize statistical methods and tools to analyze manufacturing and quality data. Establish and maintain comprehensive data management systems to track and report key quality metrics. Work closely with suppliers to ensure the quality of incoming materials and components. Conduct supplier audits and collaborate with vendors to address quality issues and improve overall supply chain quality. Participate in advanced quality planning activities for new product launches. Develop and review control plans, FMEAs, and other quality-related documents to ensure proactive quality measures are in place. Provide training to production and quality control teams on quality standards, processes, and tools. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and quality consciousness among team members. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in quality management.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong understanding of quality management systems, statistical methods, and manufacturing processes.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Effective communication and leadership abilities.
Familiarity with quality tools such as Six Sigma, FMEA, and Control Plans.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in engineering or related field.
Proven experience in a quality engineering role, with preference around robotics.

cond_0126.intro: We are looking for an Advanced Quality Engineer to join our team. This role works across product development and manufacturing to help maintain quality standards, support continuous improvement, and coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues.
cond_0126.responsibilities:
What you will do:
Coordinate APQP activities for new product launches, helping ensure compliance with customer requirements and automotive quality standards.
Work with design, engineering, and manufacturing teams to develop and maintain control plans, PFMEAs, and other APQP documentation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate quality risks early in the product development process.
Support adherence to quality standards across all stages of the manufacturing process.
Conduct regular audits together with relevant teams to assess compliance with quality specifications and standards.
Work alongside cross-functional partners to identify areas for improvement in product design and manufacturing processes.
Coordinate initiatives to apply lean manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies for process improvement and cost reduction.
Help optimize quality control processes and enhance product reliability through shared team effort.
Facilitate root cause analysis investigations for quality issues and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with relevant stakeholders.
Utilize statistical methods and tools to analyze manufacturing and quality data, sharing findings with the team.
Help establish and maintain data management systems to track and report key quality metrics.
Work closely with suppliers to help ensure the quality of incoming materials and components.
Conduct supplier audits and coordinate with vendors to address quality issues and improve overall supply chain quality.
Support advanced quality planning activities for new product launches.
Develop and review control plans, FMEAs, and other quality-related documents in collaboration with the team.
Provide training to production and quality control teams on quality standards, processes, and tools.
Help build a culture of continuous improvement and quality awareness among team members.
Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in quality management.
cond_0126.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree (4 Year Degree from College / University) in engineering or related field preferred.
Proven experience in a quality engineering role with preference around robotics.
Strong understanding of quality management systems, statistical methods, and manufacturing processes.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Effective communication and leadership abilities.
Familiarity with quality tools such as Six Sigma, FMEA, and Control Plans.

With nearly 5,600 team members worldwide, [Company name masked] collaborates across the building industry to enable and accelerate transformational breakthroughs in design and construction to transform the way the industry designs, makes, and builds.
The Advanced Quality Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring the highest standards of quality throughout the product development and manufacturing processes. They will be responsible for leading advanced quality planning initiatives, implementing continuous improvement measures, and driving root cause analysis to resolve quality issues. This role requires strong analytical skills, deep knowledge of automotive quality standards, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of quality systems and manufacturing processes.
cond_0337.responsibilities:
Lead APQP activities for new product launches, ensuring compliance with customer requirements and automotive quality standards.
Develop and maintain control plans, PFMEAs, and other APQP documentation.
Collaborate with design, engineering, and manufacturing teams to identify and mitigate quality risks early in the product development process.
Monitor and enforce adherence to quality standards in all stages of the manufacturing process.
Conduct regular audits to assess compliance with quality specifications and standards.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement in product design and manufacturing processes.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost reduction through the application of lean manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
Drive initiatives to optimize quality control processes and enhance product reliability.
Lead root cause analysis investigations for quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Utilize statistical methods and tools to analyze manufacturing and quality data.
Establish and maintain comprehensive data management systems to track and report key quality metrics.
Work closely with suppliers to ensure the quality of incoming materials and components.
Conduct supplier audits and collaborate with vendors to address quality issues and improve overall supply chain quality.
Participate in advanced quality planning activities for new product launches.
Develop and review control plans, FMEAs, and other quality-related documents to ensure proactive quality measures are in place.
Provide training to production and quality control teams on quality standards, processes, and tools.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement and quality consciousness among team members.
Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in quality management.
cond_0337.requirements: Bachelor's Degree (4 Year Degree from College / University) in engineering or related field preferred. Proven experience in a quality engineering role with preference around robotics. Strong understanding of quality management systems, statistical methods, and manufacturing processes. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Effective communication and leadership abilities. Familiarity with quality tools such as Six Sigma, FMEA, and Control Plans.

Lead APQP activities for new product launches, ensuring compliance with customer requirements and automotive quality standards. Develop and maintain control plans, PFMEAs, and other APQP documentation. Utilize statistical methods and tools to analyze manufacturing and quality data. Establish and maintain comprehensive data management systems to track and report key quality metrics. Work closely with suppliers to ensure the quality of incoming materials and components. Conduct supplier audits and collaborate with vendors to address quality issues and improve overall supply chain quality. Participate in advanced quality planning activities for new product launches. Develop and review control plans, FMEAs, and other quality-related documents to ensure proactive quality measures are in place. Provide training to production and quality control teams on quality standards, processes, and tools. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and quality consciousness among team members. cond_0458.intro: The Advanced Quality Engineer owns a critical role in ensuring the highest standards of quality throughout the product development and manufacturing processes. You will lead advanced quality planning initiatives, drive continuous improvement measures, and execute root cause analysis to resolve quality issues. This role requires strong analytical skills, deep knowledge of automotive quality standards, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
cond_0458.responsibilities:
What you will do:
Lead APQP activities for new product launches, ensuring compliance with customer requirements and automotive quality standards.
Develop and maintain control plans, PFMEAs, and other APQP documentation.
Drive collaboration with design, engineering, and manufacturing teams to identify and mitigate quality risks early in the product development process.
Enforce adherence to quality standards in all stages of the manufacturing process.
Conduct regular audits to assess compliance with quality specifications and standards.
Lead cross-functional teams in identifying areas for improvement in product design and manufacturing processes.
Identify and execute opportunities for process improvement and cost reduction through lean manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
Direct initiatives to optimize quality control processes and enhance product reliability.
Lead root cause analysis investigations for quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Utilize statistical methods and tools to analyze manufacturing and quality data.
Establish and maintain comprehensive data management systems to track and report key quality metrics.
Own supplier relationships to ensure the quality of incoming materials and components.
Conduct supplier audits and direct vendors to address quality issues and improve overall supply chain quality.
Develop and review control plans, FMEAs, and other quality-related documents to ensure proactive quality measures are in place.
Deliver training to production and quality control teams on quality standards, processes, and tools.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement and quality consciousness among team members.
Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in quality management.
cond_0458.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong understanding of quality management systems, statistical methods, and manufacturing processes.
Proven experience in a quality engineering role.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Effective communication and leadership abilities.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in engineering or a related field.
Experience in a quality engineering role with a focus on robotics.
Familiarity with quality tools such as Six Sigma, FMEA, and Control Plans.

They will be responsible for leading advanced quality planning initiatives, implementing continuous improvement measures, and driving root cause analysis to resolve quality issues. This role requires strong analytical skills, deep knowledge of automotive quality standards, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
cond_0470.responsibilities:

Lead APQP activities for new product launches, ensuring compliance with customer requirements and automotive quality standards. Develop and maintain control plans, PFMEAs, and other APQP documentation. Collaborate with design, engineering, and manufacturing teams to identify and mitigate quality risks early in the product development process. Monitor and enforce adherence to quality standards in all stages of the manufacturing process. Conduct regular audits to assess compliance with quality specifications and standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement in product design and manufacturing processes. Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost reduction through the application of lean manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies. Drive initiatives to optimize quality control processes and enhance product reliability. Lead root cause analysis investigations for quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions. Utilize statistical methods and tools to analyze manufacturing and quality data. Establish and maintain comprehensive data management systems to track and report key quality metrics. Work closely with suppliers to ensure the quality of incoming materials and components. Conduct supplier audits and collaborate with vendors to address quality issues and improve overall supply chain quality. Participate in advanced quality planning activities for new product launches. Develop and review control plans, FMEAs, and other quality-related documents to ensure proactive quality measures are in place. Provide training to production and quality control teams on quality standards, processes, and tools. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and quality consciousness among team members. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in quality management.

Deep expertise in quality tools such as Six Sigma, FMEA, and Control Plans.

This role requires strong analytical skills, deep knowledge of automotive quality standards, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
cond_0542.responsibilities:
What you will do:
Lead APQP activities for new product launches, ensuring compliance with customer requirements and automotive quality standards. Develop and maintain control plans, PFMEAs, and other APQP documentation. Collaborate with design, engineering, and manufacturing teams to identify and mitigate quality risks early in the product development process. Monitor and enforce adherence to quality standards in all stages of the manufacturing process. Conduct regular audits to assess compliance with quality specifications and standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement in product design and manufacturing processes. Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost reduction through the application of lean manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies. Drive initiatives to optimize quality control processes and enhance product reliability. Lead root cause analysis investigations for quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions. Utilize statistical methods and tools to analyze manufacturing and quality data. Establish and maintain comprehensive data management systems to track and report key quality metrics. Work closely with suppliers to ensure the quality of incoming materials and components. Conduct supplier audits and collaborate with vendors to address quality issues and improve overall supply chain quality. Participate in advanced quality planning activities for new product launches. Develop and review control plans, FMEAs, and other quality-related documents to ensure proactive quality measures are in place. Provide training to production and quality control teams on quality standards, processes, and tools. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and quality consciousness among team members. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in quality management.
cond_0542.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proven track record in a quality engineering role, with demonstrated expertise in robotics.
Advanced knowledge of quality management systems, statistical methods, and manufacturing processes.
Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Deep expertise in quality tools such as Six Sigma, FMEA, and Control Plans.
Strong leadership abilities and exceptional communication skills.
